evidence.quote: Cu-0.47Cr-0.16 Nb (wt%) alloy was melted in a vacuum induction furnace with the raw materials of electrolytic Cu, pure Cr and Nb-Cr master alloy.
After removing the surface defects, the ingot was solution-treated at 950 ℃ or 4 h in an Ar atmosphere and then quickly quenched into water.
The solution-treated alloy was then cold rolled at room temperature with a total reduction of 80% in thickness.
